gizmo.title: Umbuzo Wokufanisa
gizmo.description: Umsebenzi wokufanisa ngokudonsa nokulahla ohlanganisa imiyalo nezimpendulo zayo ezilungile.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Umbuzo wabasebenzisi. Maka izindawo zokulahla, bese ubhala izimpendulo kuze kufike indawo elandelayo.

advanced.title: Iyagoqeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lombuzo njengomugqa ovulekayo futhi uvaleke. Ukuvula owodwa kuvala eminye imibuzo egoqekayo eduze kwawo.

advanced.title: Qala igoqiwe
advanced.description: Uma igoqeka, qala njengomugqa ovaliwe obonisa umbuzo nesimo sawo kuphela.

advanced.title: Ifomethi yokumaka
advanced.description: OER Schema: ifomethi yokumaka yalokhu kuhlola (isb. amaphuzu, uhlamvu, iphesenti, ukuphothula).

advanced.title: Inhloso yokufunda
advanced.description: OER Schema: inhloso yokufunda ehlobene nalokhu kuhlola.

developer.title: Igama lemibuzo
developer.description: Igama lemibuzo elisetshenziselwa ukuhlonza kwe-xAPI ezinhlelweni zokuhlaziya.

developer.title: Isifundo
developer.description: OER Schema: isifundo lokhu kuhlola okuhloselwe sona.
